panels.description: One perspective coordinate-frame panel, not separate longitudinal and transverse rod panels.

points.label: O
points.position: Left origin at the intersection of the horizontal, upward and down-left axes.

points.label: O1
points.position: Right origin on the same horizontal baseline.

points.label: X
points.position: Rightward arrow tip on the baseline, before the X1 tip.

points.label: X1
points.position: Rightmost arrow tip on the baseline.

points.label: A
points.position: Left end of a horizontal filled rod, above the baseline and to the right of O1.

points.label: B
points.position: Right end of the same rod.
On the upward K1 axis above O1.
To the right of the velocity tail.

relationships.fact: O is the common endpoint of the X, Y and Z axes.
O1 is the common endpoint of the X1, Y1 and Z1 axes.
O, O1 and both rightward axis arrow tips lie on the same horizontal baseline.
Y and Y1 point upward in parallel; Z and Z1 point down-left in parallel.
Every coordinate axis has an outward arrowhead.
A and B label the actual left and right ends of one rod, respectively.
AB is parallel to the common horizontal X/X1 direction; A is right of O1, and B is right of A.
The velocity arrow starts on the K1 upward axis and points right, parallel to X/X1.

interpretationBoundary: The image establishes longitudinal AB and transverse coordinate directions. No transverse rod, simultaneous clocks, or numerical values may be claimed as pixel facts.
